author: Ivan Erick Tlaltecatl Morales

P01.question: Independent vs successive physical queries on acquired fixed routes
P01.criterion: Applied queries and history-conditioned residual; successive effective use count

P02.question: History-conditioned route adequacy, distinct from mere earlier emission
P02.family: C6 directional history plus future encounter
P02.criterion: reaches frozen opportunity with correct direction vs naive; first actual contact precedes declared toroidal delay?

P03.question: Contingent action, independent replay and later relational/readout state
P03.criterion: late cut/replay changes later common panel, with matching memory before replay

P04.question: Native transfer vs assisted sufficiency of partial relational state
P04.family: C6 zero relay and basal pair
P04.criterion: two source histories yield distinct receiver queries; subset restores source panel in matched background

P05.question: Different retained histories behind the same ordinary expression
P05.criterion: ordinary expression equal while admitted common mediator reveals distinct histories

P06.question: Which joint functions require distributed scaffold/history/context?
P06.criterion: common q panel differs under selective omissions/cuts; regions and latency tracked

P07.question: Does own action change write conditions or only expression?
P07.criterion: history/action cut changes effective common-E effect on A/B or expression

P08.question: Functional signature versus reappearing material and finite perturbation tolerance
P08.family: quiescent basal and prepared native contacts
P08.criterion: valid pre-damage panel restored; loss of a center never encoded as valid zero-memory

P09.question: Depth and physically connected composition across families
P09.criterion: stage histories or link cut alter final query; cross-family input changes joint panel

P10.question: Finite generalization domain, phase/timing and saturation regimes
P10.criterion: paired same-dose control and finite reserved axes; distinguish scalar coalescence from full signature

P11.question: Repair physical selectivity P versus Q before assessing preference acquisition
P11.family: relative basal + one conditional native encounter
P11.criterion: hidden variants differ in chosen P lineage, not Q, under same local prefix

P12.question: Competing acquired contributions and occupied-target precedence
P12.family: two native C6 acquisitions, shared encounter
P12.criterion: combined panel compared to single contributions, timing and occupied/protected target

P13.question: Functions hidden by local/coarse/fixed-coordinate observers
P13.criterion: same ordinary readout with distinct admitted functional probes or temporal patterns

P14.question: Open finite regularities without preassigned cognitive category
P14.criterion: specific prediction, alternative control and reserved realization
